# Bundled frontend dependencies

The workbench serves these fixed-version browser assets locally so its UI does
not rely on a public CDN at runtime.

| File | Package | Version | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `react.production.min.js` | React | 18.3.1 | MIT |
| `react-dom.production.min.js` | React DOM | 18.3.1 | MIT |
| `babel.min.js` | Babel Standalone | 7.25.6 | MIT |
| `echarts.min.js` | Apache ECharts | 5.5.1 | Apache-2.0 |

The original license notices remain in the distributed assets. Source packages:
[React](https://github.com/facebook/react),
[Babel](https://github.com/babel/babel), and
[Apache ECharts](https://github.com/apache/echarts).
